module: Technical demo of "instanced" line drawing in the debugDrawer (drawLineInstance, drawDot), which allows thick lines with an outline and rounded ends. Once loaded, the extension runs a simulation of 6 attracting masses (inspired by a JavaScript n-body) and draws their trajectories every frame at 3 m height above the origin, twice: without depth test and with it (offset by 5 m in X). The other demos (grid, sine waves, edges, traffic light) are dead code commented out in onPreRender.
notes: Trajectories accumulate (up to 10000 segments per mass, then the table is cleared): the drawing cost increases over time.
There is no clean unload: unloading the extension simply stops the drawing. Reloading the extension adds new masses without clearing the old ones (startSim does not clear the masses table).
The vec3Random(1) call ignores its argument; startSim creates nMasses+1 = 6 masses (loop from 0 to nMasses).
testGrid, drawSinWaveTest, drawEdgeTest and drawSignal are never called (calls commented out).

onPreRender.desc: Hook called every frame before rendering. Advances the demo time, performs a simulation step and draws the trajectories (without then with depth).

dtSim.desc: Simulation time delta in seconds (used by the demo)

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called when the extension is loaded: initializes the simulation masses (startSim).
